suggestion: Rank the leaderboard by Brier skill against the closing line, never by win rate
options_considered: (a) win rate, (b) flat ROI, (c) benchmark-relative Brier skill with a cluster interval
recommendation: (c) — win rate and ROI cannot separate skill from variance at any sample this project can reach
cost: HIGH — it decides what every other number means
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: the first certified strategy shows a positive lower bound after the multiplicity correction
what_would_change_our_mind: if a strategy with a negative skill interval out-earns one with a positive interval over 300 settled bets, revisit the ranking

suggestion: Publish signal and staking as two columns and never combine them
options_considered: (a) one blended score, (b) two columns, (c) staking only
recommendation: (b) — a lucky staking run must not be able to hide a negative signal
cost: HIGH — it is the difference between a scoreboard and a slot machine
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: a strategy shows staking ROI above zero while its skill interval sits wholly below zero (this already happens on the 2026 tail)
what_would_change_our_mind: if the two columns never disagree over 300 settled bets, the split is not doing work

suggestion: Estimate the availability effect as a coefficient, never apply a fixed penalty
options_considered: (a) subtract N points per missing starter, (b) estimate the coefficient with a ridge, (c) ignore availability
recommendation: (b) — a fixed penalty is an assumption dressed as a measurement
cost: HIGH — the brief forbids fixed penalties outright
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: the estimated coefficient keeps its sign across three rolling origins
what_would_change_our_mind: if the coefficient flips sign between origins, drop the feature and publish that result

suggestion: Define depth as playing-time share inside a position group
options_considered: (a) parse 32 club depth pages, (b) usage rank from snap share, (c) both
recommendation: (b) — measurable, uniform across clubs, and impossible to corrupt with jersey order
cost: MEDIUM — it changes the depth tables and the deficiency view
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: a club publishes a structured official depth feed that disagrees with the usage rank for more than 5% of slots
what_would_change_our_mind: if such a feed appears, add it as a cross-check and publish the disagreements instead of replacing the measured rank

suggestion: Treat any closing-line bias as a hypothesis that must be pre-registered
options_considered: (a) use it now, (b) pre-register a 2026-only test with a frozen threshold, (c) ignore it
recommendation: (b) — a bias found by looking at the holdout has spent that holdout
cost: HIGH — using a discovered effect as if it were a prediction is the classic error
review_status: draft — awaiting the owner's decision; nothing is implemented
condition_to_accept: a frozen threshold committed before the next kickoff
what_would_change_our_mind: if a prospective sample of at least 100 games shows the bias with the same sign, promote it to a candidate family

suggestion: Keep the combo gate closed until a joint probability exists
options_considered: (a) multiply marginal probabilities, (b) block combos, (c) rank them with a warning
recommendation: (b) — multiplying marginals under dependence is arithmetically wrong, not merely risky
cost: HIGH — it prevents publishing a number that cannot be true
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: a fitted joint distribution beats the independent product by more than one percentage point on held-out games, with n published
what_would_change_our_mind: if the measured dependence is negligible for a specific leg set, open that set alone

suggestion: Publish the weekly residual against the market instead of a pick
options_considered: (a) publish picks, (b) publish the residual series, (c) both
recommendation: (b) — a residual accumulates evidence whether or not anyone bets; a pick invites result-chasing
cost: MEDIUM — it changes what the front page shows
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: four consecutive weekly residual snapshots with a consistent sign
what_would_change_our_mind: if the residuals show no persistence over four weeks, stop publishing them weekly

suggestion: Admit only stamped, hashed availability reads as evidence
options_considered: (a) trust the tables already in the repository, (b) re-read and hash, (c) both
recommendation: (b) — the repository already contains one capture that asked for Week 11 and received Week 10, so provenance has to be re-checked at every build
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: two independent reads of the same page disagree
what_would_change_our_mind: if two reads a day apart agree on every cell, relax to one read per day

suggestion: Put a control baseline in every scored table, not only the leaderboard
recommendation: (b) — a control is the only way a reader can tell whether a number is any good
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: every scored table carries a control row
what_would_change_our_mind: if a control ever outranks the model, the model adds nothing and the table says so

suggestion: Settle the price-data policy before publishing any backtest figure
options_considered: (a) backtest first, (b) a written price policy first, (c) no policy
recommendation: (b) — a backtest against an unnamed price is not reproducible
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: the policy carries a date and a scope before the first figure
what_would_change_our_mind: if a named-operator closing series with a verifiable stamp appears, widen the policy to row-level prices

suggestion: Print the number that would clear each gate beside the gate
options_considered: (a) a status word only, (b) status plus the clearing number
recommendation: (b) — "blocked" without a number is not a decision aid
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: every blocked row carries a number
what_would_change_our_mind: if a row cannot be given a number, it is a question rather than a requirement

suggestion: Make the questions register carry the discovery route, not just the gap
options_considered: (a) a list of gaps, (b) gap plus route plus blocker
recommendation: (b) — a gap with no route is a complaint
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
what_would_change_our_mind: if a route proves impossible, demote the question to a rejected item with the reason

suggestion: Publish two total estimators side by side until one wins out of sample
options_considered: (a) pick one now, (b) keep both with a gap column
recommendation: (b) — the gap is the evidence, and choosing now would be choosing before the evidence
review_status: draft — awaiting the owner's decision; nothing is implemented
condition_to_accept: a frozen comparison plan, then the gap over a full season
what_would_change_our_mind: if the second estimator never beats the first out of sample, retire it and publish the result

suggestion: Show replacement depth as a measured gap, never as a claim about who started
options_considered: (a) assert that a backup replaced a starter, (b) publish the usage gap
recommendation: (b) — there is no official inactive list in the repository, so a replacement can be bounded but not named
review_status: accepted 2026-11-19 by this session and built here; the evidence path is the check
condition_to_accept: an official inactive list or Game Book is captured
what_would_change_our_mind: if the inactive list confirms a replacement, publish it as confirmed and keep the measured gap beside it
